question: With which of the following measures can we reduce the amplitude of a confidence interval?

options.opa: Increasing the sample size or decreasing the degree of confidence.
options.opb: Decreasing the sample size or decreasing the degree of confidence.
options.opc: Increasing the sample size or decreasing the statistical power.
options.opd: Increasing the sample size or increasing the degree of confidence.

analysis: To reduce the amplitude of a confidence interval, we need to make the interval narrower. This can be achieved by either increasing the sample size or increasing the degree of confidence. Both of these actions will lead to a more precise estimate of the true population parameter.
